dialect.detail: Standard COBOL-85 style; no vendor-specific extensions. Likely compiled with GnuCOBOL or similar open-source compiler given LINE SEQUENTIAL organization and simple file assignments. Author 'PEGGY FISHER' is a known COBOL educator/author.

purpose.domain_detail: Sales data validation for a sales personnel yearly sales file
purpose.summary: Reads a flat file of salesperson yearly sales records, validates each record for numeric ID, alphabetic names, valid region codes (EAST/WEST/NORTH/SOUTH), numeric sales amount, and valid gender code (M/F/U). Writes valid records to a new file and prints an error report for invalid records, stopping early if more than 5 bad records are found.

notable_features: 88-level condition names for end-of-file and valid-gender
PERFORM THRU range across multiple paragraphs
GO TO used for early termination on excessive errors
ACCEPT FROM DATE for report date stamping
Structured report with heading and detail lines
No COMP-3, no SQL, no CICS
verdict.notes: The PROCEDURE DIVISION is present in the source despite the mechanical indicator showing it absent — likely a parsing artifact. The program is consistent with a textbook or course exercise by educator Peggy Fisher. No lines exceed 72 characters confirming fixed format. The early-exit logic via GO TO on >5 bad records is a deliberate teaching example of that construct.
